chunks: A man complained to the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, of loneliness, so he instructed him to keep a pair of pigeons.

key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْوَحْشَةَ: loneliness, estrangement, or a sense of isolation

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم advise someone who complained of loneliness?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that a man complained of loneliness to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and he advised him to keep a pair of pigeons. It reflects a Prophetic response to emotional isolation through a simple and permissible means.
